releaseNotes: 📱 Fresh & Compact Dashboard: The entire dashboard now fits cleanly on your screen with zero abbreviations on pipeline and quick tools.
🏠 First-Time Home Buyer Exemption: 1-tap toggle for 100% MOT Stamp Duty exemption with live cash savings display.
📈 Visual DSR Health Gauge: Color-coded progress bar showing loan approval chances at a glance, plus 1-tap bank limit chips and dedicated PTPTN loan deductions.
🧮 Enhanced Calculators: Improved 6-month average income tool for variable/OT salary, plus instant cross-tab loan calculation bridge.
🔄 Smoother Navigation & Cleaner Sharing: Back button from calculator returns directly to the exact listing, with symmetric WhatsApp and Copy buttons.
📰 Daily Digest Briefing (9:00 AM): Automatically receive your morning active case summary from Firebase Cloud (Turn ON in Profile > Notification Settings).
